description:
Problem: the whole-tree comment-policy scan (scripts/run_comment_policy.py --full) runs nightly (.github/workflows/comment-policy-nightly.yml:20-71) but not in .github/workflows/trunk.yml. On 2026-10-24 the bad scope entry from #3168 (39a942435ae7fe9fc78afabb3a0182b0bbf4c317) got a green Trunk run (40069594552). It was noticed only when unrelated PRs failed tooling and the nightly failed on c962e3e8733e9107988ba05145d09a27717a8fda (run 40082466628).

Outcome: every develop push runs the full scan as its own Trunk job, and the job prints the checked SHA. A scan failure turns Trunk red, and trunk-status and the arm gate then name the commit that introduced it. Detection only: prevention is the head-policy validation item.

Decision gates:
1. Recovery path. A scan failure engages the arm gate and the pr-open refusal. A failure caused by an invalid base policy cannot be repaired by a revert PR, because that PR's own comment-policy check runs against the broken base. Its recovery is the owner break-glass procedure. Land only after head-policy validation and the documented break-glass procedure are on develop. For a source-file violation, make trunk-revert PR=<n> is the recovery.
2. Cost (measured). The scan step took 64 s on a hosted runner (nightly run 40182292524) and Trunk's jobs run in parallel, so it runs as a separate parallel job. Stop and report if the new job's measured duration in the first live run exceeds the fast job's duration.
3. Keep the nightly scan as a backstop; do not remove it.

Item guardrails: detection only; never auto-revert and never open issues from Trunk. No change to the PR-time check. No new required context, which is owner-only.

Common guardrails: work only in a linked worktree created by make worktree-create, after make agent-write-preflight; the primary clone is read-only. No SKIP or --no-verify, no stand-in approvals, no ruleset edits or bypasses, no raw gh pr merge. Do not change oracle-gate's App binding (integration 5201041), the oracle decision rule, or the native review-thread-resolution requirement. Do not close and reopen, mass-rerun or rebase other pull requests. No explanatory comments or docstrings in code; commits, PR bodies and docs carry no tracker item IDs or session labels; timing uses benchbox.utils.clock.mono_time().
